rows.author: D003
rows.title_full: AN ACT ALLOWING AN INTERNATIONAL CARGO VESSEL TO SHIFT CONTAINERS OF ANY FOREIGN LINES AND THE TRANSSHIPMENT OF CARGO HEADED TO AND FROM ANY PHILIPPINE OUTPORT, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE \"THE TARIFF AND CUSTOMS CODE OF THE PHILIPPINES\"
rows.title_short: Philippine Export and Import Freight Shipping Assistance Act of 2004
rows.abstract: \"Philippine Export and Import Freight Shipping Assistance Act of 2004.\" This bill defines certain nautical terms to clarify meanings in the context of the Philippine setting. It further amends the Tariff and Customs Code of the Philippines, viz: Section 905. Vessel Eligible for Coastwise Trade. - THE RIGHT TO ENGAGE IN THE PHILIPPINE COASTWISE TRADE IS LIMITED TO VESSELS CARRYING A CERTIFICATE OF PHILIPPINE REGISTRY. COASTWISE TRADE SHALL NOT EMBRACE OR COVER THE GOODS, ARTICLES, COMMODITIES OR MERCHANDISE CLASSIFIED OR DESIGNATED AS FOREIGN CARGOES AS THEREIN DEFINED. It also amends Section 1009 of the same Code by providing clearance to FOREIGN TRADE TO LOAD OR UNLOAD FOREIGN CARGOES TO AND FROM PRINCIPAL PORTS OF ENTRY/SUB-PORTS IN THE COUNTRY through THE FOLLOWING INSTANCES: 1) ALLOWING AN INTERNATIONAL CARGO VESSEL TO SHIFT EMPTY CONTAINERS OF ANY FOREIGN LINES IF SAID VESSEL REGULARLY CALLS AT MANILA AND PROCEEDS TO PHILIPPINE OUTPORTS; and 2) ALLOWING TRANSSHIPMENT BY ANY INTERNATIONAL VESSEL OF CARGO COMING FROM OR HEADED FOR A FOREIGN PORT AND FROM ANY PHILIPPINE OUTPORT.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on TRADE AND INDUSTRY since 2004-08-04

rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR A NEW QUEDAN SYSTEM IN THE MARKETING OF PALAY AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.abstract: This bill mandates the National Food Authority (NFA) to determine the floor price for palay to assure the farmers or producers a fair return on their investment and to procure and buy from  farmers their palay crops subject to the following payment terms: (a)seventy-five percent in cash, and (b) a quedan for the remaining balance which shall be paid within sixty days from the time the palay is delivered to its warehouses or within such time as may be agreed upon by the NFA and the farmers/producers.

rows.abstract: This bill establishes the Solar Energy Development Authority which shall undertake researches, and promote the development and utilization of the solar energy. rows.title_full: AN ACT REQUIRING THE IMPOUNDING OF MOTOR VEHICLES INVOLVED IN A VEHICULAR INCIDENT THAT RESULTED IN THE DEATH OR SERIOUS PHYSICAL INJURY OF A PEDESTRIAN, COMMUTER OR BY-STANDER, UNLESS A CASH BOND IS POSTED
rows.abstract: This bill mandates that any motor vehicle which directly figured in a vehicular incident that resulted in the death or serious physical injury of a pedestrian, commuter, or by-stander who is not a passenger of such vehicle, shall be held in custodia legis, pending the outcome of any criminal or civil proceeding as a result of the same incident, unless the driver, owner or operator of the vehicle shall post a cash bond in the amount of at least Five Hundred Thousand Pesos (PhP500,000.00) as security for the satisfaction of any judgment that may be rendered by the court.
rows.status: Substituted by HB04892

rows.title_short: Public Health Workers Compensation Structure of 2004
rows.abstract: \"Public Health Workers Compensation Structure of 2004.\" This bill declares it a State policy to establish a highly motivated salary structure for public health workers to prevent the imminent and inevitable collapse of the Health System in the country. Provides for the upgrading of the basic salary of health workers with Salary Grade 22 and below by 2 salary grades.

rows.title_full: AN ACT INSTITUTING A CONGRESSIONAL MEDAL OF HONOR AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.title_short: Instituting a Congressional Medal of Honor
rows.abstract: This bill establishes a Congressional Medal of Honor to recognize members of the Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP) and the Philippine National Police (PNP) who, whether in times of peace or of war have, through their heroic and selfless deeds, distinguished themselves above and beyond the call of duty. Aside from a Medal, this recognition will also involve the promotion of the soldier or police officer to the next higher rank, and shall include the grant of P100,000.00 to the awardee or to his or her next-of-kin.

rows.author: D099
rows.title_full: AN ACT DECLARING A NATIONAL POLICY ON PEACE ZONES
rows.title_short: The Peace Zones Policy Act of 2004
rows.abstract: \"The Peace Zones Policy Act of 2004.\" This bill establishes the basic and specific policies that shall govern Peace Zones. Because of the intermittent armed conflict in Mindanao, people-initiated, community-based responses in the form of Peace Zones, also known as \"Sanctuaries of Peace\" and \"Spaces for Peace\" have mushroomed in the area. A peace zone is a geographical area which the residents themselves declare to be off-limits to armed conflicts to protect the civilians, livelihood and property from the raging war. It comprises a major grassroots constituency in the pursuit of peace processes in the national level.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on NATIONAL DEFENSE AND SECURITY since 2004-08-09

rows.title_short: Fair Competition Law of the Philippines
rows.abstract: \"Fair Competition Law of the Philippines.\" This bill aims to level the business playing field by strengthening the legal and institutional framework that would combat unfair trade practices. Among the key features of the measure include: a) the creation of a Fair Trade Commission that shall investigate, gather evidence and initiate prosecution of those engaged in unfair trade practices; b) the description of monopoly power or market abuse; and c) the imposition of defined sanctions to key officials of companies that violate fair competition.

rows.abstract: Rationale: Education Supervisors perform several major functions such as training, monitoring and consulting pertaining to the specific instruction program they are handling. Apart from rendering their expert and technical services to several school districts and hundred of teachers and school administrators, they are also doing administrative and other works delegated to them by their Superintendents and Assistant Superintendents, thus the necessity of upgrading their salary grades.

rows.abstract: This bill exempts the family home from the payment of real property taxes in order to unburden them from the difficulty of maintaining a shelter for their families. This bill is expected to alleviate the plight of many Filipinos who have found it almost impossible to build a home of their own.
